# HOST_RESOLVER

A resolver on the lab's network, as another container on it reaches it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `resolver`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.resolver`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
